source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: After both armies deploy, rules that redeploy units are resolved here unless they say otherwise, alternating with the Attacker first. Units put into **[strategic reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves)** during this step don't count towards your [strategic reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves) points total.

detail.resolves: redeploy rules, unless they state otherwise
detail.strategicReserves: excluded from the strategic reserves points total when placed there during this step
